name: @tennotools/profile-check
description: TennoTools Profile Check — the Warframe profile-parser canary (local live-check, TS monorepo)

scripts.build: npm -w @tennotools/profile-check-core run build && npm -w @tennotools/profile-check-server run build && npm -w @tennotools/profile-check-web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @tennotools/profile-check-core run typecheck && npm -w @tennotools/profile-check-server run typecheck && npm -w @tennotools/profile-check-web run typecheck
